name: Power BI
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)

beginner.summary: For business users and analysts new to Power BI. Covers connecting to data, cleaning it with Power Query, building a data model, writing first DAX measures, designing reports and dashboards, and publishing and sharing in the Power BI service, ending with a complete sales report.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Excel: tables, filters and simple formulas
Understands basic business measures such as revenue and margin
Power BI Desktop installed and a work or trial account for the service
outcomes: Import and clean data with Power Query
Build a star-schema data model with relationships
Write basic DAX measures and time intelligence
Design, publish and share clear reports and dashboards

days.topic: Power BI Overview, Setup and First Report
subtopics: What Power BI is used for
Power BI Desktop, Service and Mobile
Licences: Free, Pro, Premium Per User and Fabric capacity
The Report, Data and Model views
days.lab_task: Install Power BI Desktop, load the sample sales workbook, build a page with a revenue card, a bar chart by region and a slicer for year, and publish it to a workspace.
days.deliverable: PBIX file and published report link
checks: Select a year in the slicer
Open the report in the service
objectives: Explain the Power BI parts and licences

days.lab_task: Connect to an Excel workbook, a folder of monthly CSV files, a SQL database table and a SharePoint list, and explain which connection mode suits each.
days.deliverable: PBIX with four sources and a connection mode note
checks: Add a new CSV to the folder and refresh

days.lab_task: Clean a messy sales export with wrong types, blank rows, merged name columns and error values, so it loads with no errors and correct totals.
days.deliverable: Cleaned query with documented steps
checks: Compare total sales with the reference
Each step has a clear name

days.topic: Shaping Data: Merge, Append, Pivot and Unpivot
days.lab_task: Append twelve monthly sheets, unpivot a budget table from wide months to rows, merge in product categories and group sales by category and month.
days.deliverable: Shaped queries and result tables
checks: Row count equals the sum of the sheets
One row per product and month
Merge with a left outer join

days.topic: Data Modelling: Star Schema and Relationships
subtopics: Why a flat table causes problems
days.lab_task: Turn a single flat sales table into a star schema with Sales, Customer, Product and Date tables, create relationships and show a total that is wrong in the flat model and right in the star.
days.deliverable: PBIX with the star schema and a before and after comparison
checks: One-to-many relationships from dimensions to the fact
Flat model is wrong, star model is right

days.topic: DAX Essentials: Calculated Columns and Measures
days.lab_task: Create measures for revenue, cost, margin, margin percent and order count, a calculated column for price band, and show how the measures change by region and year.
days.deliverable: PBIX with measures and a test page
checks: Compare margin percent with a spreadsheet
Divide by zero for a region with no sales
DIVIDE returns blank, not an error
Explain why margin percent should be a measure

days.topic: DAX with CALCULATE and Filter Context
subtopics: Testing measures in a table visual
days.lab_task: Write measures for sales in a chosen region, percent of total sales, sales for all products ignoring the slicer and high-value order count, and test each in a table.
days.deliverable: Measures and a test table
checks: Compute percent of total by region

days.lab_task: Add year-to-date, previous year, year-over-year growth and a three-month moving average for revenue, using an April-to-March fiscal year.
days.deliverable: Time intelligence measures and a trend page
checks: Check fiscal year-to-date at the end of June
Check year-over-year growth for one month
Show the moving average on a line chart

subtopics: Cards, bar, line and combo charts
days.lab_task: Redesign a cluttered provided report into a clear one-page sales overview using a theme, a consistent layout and the right visual for each question.
days.deliverable: Before and after report pages and a design note
checks: Ask a colleague three questions using the new page
All answered in under a minute
Each visual linked to a question

days.topic: Interactivity: Slicers, Filters, Drill-Through and Bookmarks
days.lab_task: Add synced slicers, a product drill-through page, a tooltip page, a date hierarchy drill-down and bookmark buttons that switch between chart and table views.
days.deliverable: Interactive report
checks: Details page filtered to that product
View switches between chart and table

days.topic: Publishing and the Power BI Service
days.lab_task: Publish the report to a workspace, pin key visuals to a dashboard, publish an app to a test audience and set up an email subscription.
days.deliverable: Workspace, dashboard, app and subscription
checks: Open the app as a viewer
Viewer sees the report but cannot edit

days.lab_task: Install a gateway, configure a SQL source, schedule refresh twice a day, break the credentials to cause a failure and fix it from the refresh history.
days.deliverable: Gateway configuration, schedule and refresh history

days.lab_task: Add dynamic row-level security so each regional manager sees only their region using a user mapping table, test with View as and assign groups in the service.
days.deliverable: Security roles, mapping table and test screenshots
checks: View as a user not in the mapping
Open the app as a regional manager

subtopics: Connecting Excel to a semantic model
Power BI visuals in PowerPoint and Teams
When to use Excel or Power BI
days.lab_task: Build a pivot table in Excel on the published semantic model, add a live Power BI page to a PowerPoint deck and a Teams channel, and explain when Excel is the better tool.
days.deliverable: Excel workbook, PowerPoint deck and Teams tab
checks: Review the note on Excel versus Power BI
objectives: Use Power BI with Excel and Office

subtopics: Measures versus calculated columns for size
days.lab_task: Measure a slow report with the performance analyser, cut model size by removing columns and reducing cardinality, reduce visuals and show the load time drop.
days.deliverable: Performance results before and after
checks: Measure page load before and after

days.lab_task: Build an executive dashboard that shows performance against target with conditional formatting, a narrative summary and a Q&A visual, and test it with two users.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and user test notes
checks: Variance coloured red or green by rule
Ask Q&A "sales by region last year"
Both find the main message in under 30 seconds

subtopics: What Copilot can do in Power BI
days.lab_task: Use Copilot to draft a report page, write two DAX measures and summarise a page, then check every result against your own measures and fix the errors.
days.deliverable: Copilot outputs, checks and corrections
checks: Verified or corrected against a known value
Every claim matches the data or is corrected

days.topic: Organising and Governing Power BI Content
days.lab_task: Organise a messy workspace into development and production workspaces, certify the main semantic model, apply sensitivity labels and use usage metrics to retire unused reports.
days.deliverable: Workspace plan, labelled content and retirement list
checks: Label shows and carries into exported files

days.lab_task: Build a printable invoice-style paginated report with parameters for customer and month, grouping by order and page breaks, then publish and export it to PDF.
days.deliverable: Paginated report and exported PDF
checks: Run for one customer and month
Each order starts on a new page

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Sales Performance Report Suite
subtopics: Power Query and the data model
days.lab_task: Build a sales report suite from three sources with a star schema, measures with time intelligence, overview and detail pages, drill-through, row-level security, scheduled refresh and an app, then demo it.
days.deliverable: PBIX, published app, refresh history and a 10-minute demo
checks: Compare yearly revenue with the source
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one report suite

intermediate.summary: For analysts who build Power BI reports. Covers advanced Power Query and M, data modelling patterns, deeper DAX including context transition and iterators, calculation groups, composite models, incremental refresh, deployment pipelines, Fabric integration, performance tuning and governance.
prerequisites: Builds Power BI reports with a star schema and basic DAX
Publishes reports to the Power BI service
outcomes: Write advanced M and DAX with confidence
Design scalable models with composite and incremental refresh
Manage the lifecycle of Power BI content with deployment pipelines and Git

days.topic: Advanced Power Query and the M Language
subtopics: M syntax: let, in and steps
days.lab_task: Write a custom M function that cleans one monthly file, apply it to a folder with parameters, handle files with errors and check which steps fold to the source.
days.deliverable: Function, queries and folding notes
checks: Add a corrupt file to the folder
Load continues and the file is reported
View native query on a SQL source

subtopics: Slowly changing dimensions in Power BI
Budget and actual at different grains
days.lab_task: Model order date and ship date as role-playing dates, a many-to-many customer segment bridge and budget at month grain against daily actuals, and test each pattern.
days.deliverable: Model and test page
checks: Customers in several segments counted once in totals
Compare budget and actual by month

subtopics: Row context and filter context in depth
days.lab_task: Write measures for weighted average price, rank of customers by revenue, average monthly sales per customer and top-customer flags, and debug one wrong measure.
days.deliverable: Measures and debug notes
checks: Ranks match the reference including ties

days.lab_task: Build ABC classification, new versus returning customers, inventory closing balances and a what-if price change parameter, and validate each against reference numbers.
days.deliverable: Measures and analysis page
checks: Count new customers in a month
Show closing inventory for a quarter
Uses the last date, not the sum

days.topic: Financial Reporting in Power BI: P&L, Balance Sheet and Variance Analysis
subtopics: Chart of accounts as a dimension
Profit and loss layouts with a matrix
days.lab_task: Build a P&L and balance sheet from general ledger data with an account hierarchy, correct signs, custom subtotal lines and budget variance, and reconcile both to the trial balance.
days.deliverable: Finance report pages and reconciliation sheet
checks: Reconcile net profit with the trial balance
Show the balance sheet for a quarter
Show budget variance percent by account
Signs and percentages correct for income and expense lines

days.lab_task: Replace 30 time intelligence measures with one calculation group, add dynamic format strings and a field parameter that switches the chart's measure and axis.
days.deliverable: Model with calculation group and field parameters
checks: Apply YTD from the calculation group to three measures
objectives: Build dynamic reports with field parameters

days.lab_task: Build a composite model with a DirectQuery fact of 500 million rows, an import aggregation table and dual dimensions, and show which queries hit the aggregation.
days.deliverable: Composite model and query evidence

days.lab_task: Configure incremental refresh for five years of history with daily refresh of the last ten days, add a real-time partition and inspect partitions through the XMLA endpoint.
days.deliverable: Refresh policy, partitions and refresh times
checks: Compare refresh time with full refresh
Insert a new row in the source
Shows in the real-time partition without refresh

days.lab_task: Analyse a slow model with VertiPaq Analyzer and server timings, fix two expensive columns and three slow measures, and show the query time and size improvement.
days.deliverable: Analysis before and after and changes

subtopics: Deployment rules for parameters and sources
Power BI Projects (PBIP) and Git integration
days.lab_task: Save the report as a PBIP project in Git, deploy through dev, test and prod with rules that switch the database, review a change in a pull request and roll it back.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, Git repository and release record
checks: Test points to the test database
Model and report changes visible as text

subtopics: When to use Fabric for BI
days.lab_task: Load sales data into a Fabric lakehouse with a Dataflow Gen2, build a Direct Lake semantic model on it and compare speed and refresh needs with an import model.
days.deliverable: Lakehouse, Direct Lake model and comparison
checks: Build a report on Direct Lake

days.lab_task: Move shared preparation into a dataflow, publish one certified semantic model, rebuild three reports as thin reports on it and check impact before a model change.
days.deliverable: Dataflow, shared model, thin reports and impact analysis
checks: Dataflow, model and thin reports linked
Run impact analysis before a change
Count semantic models before and after

days.lab_task: Implement hierarchy-based RLS where managers see their whole team, hide salary columns with object-level security and test ten users.
days.deliverable: Security model, test results and documentation
checks: Sees their team and below only

days.lab_task: Build a custom bullet chart with Deneb, SVG sparklines in a table, a key influencers analysis of churn and check the page for accessibility.
days.deliverable: Report page and accessibility check
checks: Alt text and tab order set

subtopics: Embedding options: secure embed, embed for your organisation, embed for your customers
days.lab_task: Embed a report in a small web app using a service principal and embed tokens with RLS per customer, and set filters from the app with the JavaScript API.
days.deliverable: Web app with embedded report
checks: Change a filter from the app

days.topic: Power BI Administration and Tenant Settings
days.lab_task: Review and set ten tenant settings for a company policy, extract a week of activity events with the admin API and report who shared content externally.
days.deliverable: Settings record and activity report
checks: Option no longer available to users

days.lab_task: Use the capacity metrics app to find the items using most capacity, reduce their usage, and produce a capacity plan for 30 percent growth.
days.deliverable: Capacity analysis, fixes and plan

days.lab_task: Write DAX query tests that compare key measures to source totals, run Best Practice Analyzer, fix the findings and run a user acceptance test with sign-off.
days.deliverable: Test queries, analyser results, UAT record and sign-off
checks: Each test case passed or fixed

days.topic: Automation with Power Automate and the REST API
days.lab_task: Trigger a refresh after a source file lands, send a Teams message when a KPI breaches its alert, and export a report to PDF by API every Monday.
days.deliverable: Flows, scripts and evidence of runs
checks: Push a KPI below its threshold

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Enterprise Sales Analytics Solution
days.lab_task: Deliver a shared semantic model with calculation groups, incremental refresh, hierarchy RLS and OLS, three thin reports, deployment pipelines with Git, tests and automated alerts, then present it.
days.deliverable: PBIP repository, deployed workspaces, test results and a 15-minute demo
checks: Deploy a change through the pipeline
Reaches production with the right sources
Each sees the correct rows and columns
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one solution

advanced.summary: For senior Power BI developers, BI architects and Fabric analytics engineers. Covers BI architecture at enterprise scale, tabular model internals, advanced DAX optimisation, semantic model engineering with external tools and Git, Fabric and Direct Lake design, governance, security, embedding at scale, AI and a BI centre of excellence.
prerequisites: Builds enterprise Power BI models with advanced DAX
Uses deployment pipelines, Tabular Editor and DAX Studio
Has managed shared models for many users
outcomes: Architect enterprise BI on Power BI and Fabric
Engineer and optimise large tabular models
Govern, secure and automate BI at scale
Lead a BI centre of excellence

days.topic: Enterprise BI Architecture with Power BI and Fabric
subtopics: Centralised, self-service and managed self-service BI
Lakehouse, warehouse and semantic model layers
days.lab_task: Design the BI architecture for a group with eight business units, covering semantic layers, domains, workspaces, capacities and residency, and record the decisions.
days.deliverable: Architecture and decision records
checks: Shared and local models clearly separated

days.lab_task: Explain the query plans and xmSQL of five measures, find callbacks and materialisation, and change model design to remove them.
days.deliverable: Query plan analysis and changes

days.lab_task: Optimise the ten slowest measures of a provided model, benchmark each before and after with cold and warm cache and document the patterns used.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results and pattern notes

days.topic: Semantic Model Engineering with Tabular Editor and C# Scripts
days.lab_task: Write C# scripts that create standard measures for every numeric column, add descriptions and display folders, add custom BPA rules and generate model documentation.
days.deliverable: Scripts, BPA rules and generated documentation

days.topic: Version Control and CI/CD for Semantic Models
subtopics: Automated BPA and DAX tests in CI
Deploying with Fabric APIs or Tabular Editor CLI
days.lab_task: Build a CI pipeline that runs BPA and DAX tests on every pull request and a release pipeline that deploys models to test and production with approvals.
days.deliverable: Pipeline definitions and release records
checks: Open a pull request that breaks a BPA rule
Waits for approval and then deploys

days.topic: Direct Lake and Fabric Semantic Model Design
subtopics: Direct Lake internals: framing and transcoding
V-Order and table design in the lakehouse
days.lab_task: Migrate an import model to Direct Lake, design lakehouse tables to avoid fallback, measure performance and control framing after loads.
days.deliverable: Migrated model, table design and measurements
checks: Compare speed with the import model
Framing updates the model as scheduled

days.topic: Fabric Analytics Engineering: Lakehouse, Warehouse and Notebooks for BI
days.lab_task: Build bronze, silver and gold layers in Fabric with a pipeline and notebook, expose gold through a warehouse and Direct Lake model and validate measures from a notebook with Semantic Link.
days.deliverable: Fabric items, pipeline runs and validation notebook

subtopics: Refresh orchestration with XMLA and APIs
days.lab_task: Partition a 2-billion-row model by month with custom partitions, refresh partitions in parallel from a script, enable query scale-out and measure the effect.
days.deliverable: Partition design, refresh script and measurements
checks: Completes faster than one by one

days.topic: Real-Time Analytics with Power BI and Fabric
subtopics: Real-time options: Direct Lake, DirectQuery, eventstreams
days.lab_task: Stream order events into a Fabric eventhouse, build a real-time dashboard with KQL and an Activator alert for failed payments, and measure end-to-end latency.
days.deliverable: Eventstream, dashboard, alert and latency measurement
checks: Appears on the dashboard within seconds
Send failed payments over the threshold
Write a KQL query for the last hour

days.topic: Advanced Security: SSO, Data Masking and Zero Trust for BI
subtopics: RLS and OLS with service principals
Private links for Power BI and Fabric
days.lab_task: Set up SSO from a DirectQuery model to the database, apply DLP policies for personal data, restrict access through a private link and audit sensitive report views.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and audit evidence
checks: Query as two users through SSO
Upload a model with card numbers
Search audit logs for views of a sensitive report

days.topic: Governance at Scale and the BI Centre of Excellence
days.lab_task: Design a BI centre of excellence with roles, certification process, templates and adoption metrics, and pilot the certification process on two semantic models.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence design, templates and pilot results
checks: Run the certification process on two models

days.topic: Monitoring, Auditing and Usage Analytics at Scale
days.lab_task: Build a tenant monitoring model from activity events and the scanner API, find duplicate and unused content and automate archiving of reports unused for 90 days.
days.deliverable: Monitoring model, findings and archive automation
checks: Unused reports are moved and owners notified

days.topic: Embedding at Scale for Multi-Tenant Applications
days.lab_task: Build automated tenant onboarding that creates a workspace, deploys a report and sets security for each new customer, then load-test 50 concurrent tenant users.
days.deliverable: Onboarding automation, load test results and cost per tenant

days.topic: AI and Copilot in Enterprise BI
subtopics: Copilot for report authors and consumers
Preparing semantic models for AI: descriptions, synonyms, linguistic schema
Evaluating AI answers on BI data
days.lab_task: Prepare a semantic model for AI with descriptions and synonyms, build a data agent on it, evaluate 30 business questions and set rules for AI use.
days.deliverable: Prepared model, agent, evaluation and usage rules
checks: Accuracy recorded before and after model preparation
Ask a question needing a filter

days.topic: Migrating from Other BI Tools to Power BI
subtopics: Assessing Tableau, Qlik, SSRS and Excel estates
days.lab_task: Assess a provided Tableau and SSRS estate, rationalise 50 reports into a migration plan, rebuild two and validate them against the originals.
days.deliverable: Assessment, plan, rebuilt reports and validation
checks: Each migrated, merged or retired with a reason

days.topic: Advanced Data Visualisation and Report Engineering
subtopics: Mobile and accessibility design at scale
days.lab_task: Build a corporate theme and template, a report using visual calculations, an accessible mobile layout and a design review checklist, and review two existing reports.
days.deliverable: Theme, template, report and design reviews
checks: Apply the theme to a report
Use a visual calculation for a running total
Review two reports with the checklist

days.lab_task: Resolve four injected issues (a gateway failure, a throttled capacity, an RLS leak and a wrong measure), find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident records, fixes and runbooks

days.lab_task: Build a BI strategy for a provided company with a KPI framework, licensing and capacity plan, data literacy programme and roadmap, and present it to a mock leadership team.
days.deliverable: Strategy document, cost plan and presentation
checks: KPIs tied to goals with owners

days.topic: BI Architecture Reviews and Design Authority
days.lab_task: Review two provided enterprise models and their reports, find anti-patterns, write decision records and defend recommendations to a mock design authority.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records and presentation

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise BI Platform on Fabric
subtopics: Fabric lakehouse and Direct Lake models
days.lab_task: Deliver an enterprise BI platform with medallion layers in Fabric, Direct Lake semantic models under CI/CD, real-time dashboards, security and DLP, tenant monitoring, embedded reports and an AI data agent, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Fabric workspaces, repositories, monitoring model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Open a pull request that breaks a model rule
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
